# Token Requirement

A GitHub token must be provided via environment variable KC_GITHUB_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN, or be accessible via the gh CLI. If none is available, initialization fails with a ForgeError.

To ensure that all GitHub API requests are authenticated and to handle CI and developer workflows appropriately.
